name: zsnd_stream_request_match_request_predicate
description: zSndStreamRequest::MatchRequestPredicate returns zero when the active-list payload is the requested stream handle and nonzero otherwise.
known_limits: tier S verification is tracked separately by the zsnd_stream_request_match_request_predicate VC manifest.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a51e0 validates ECX/EDX pointer comparison, zero return for equality, and one return for inequality.

The native smoke routes zSndStreamRequest_StopIfActive through zArchiveList_FindPayloadByPredicate; the request is found and marked finished only when the recovered predicate reports a zero-valued match.
